title: Ghost Inventory
description: Adds a "Ghost" storage menu that catches picked-up items when your inventory is full for 300 seconds.
body:
<center>

# Ghost Inventory
**An autonomous safety net for your items.**

---

### Key Features

</center>

* **Smart Interception**: Automatically detects when you attempt to pick up an item while your inventory is at maximum capacity.
* **Hidden Buffer System**: Excess items are moved to a server-side "Ghost Buffer" rather than remaining on the ground.
* **The Ghost Menu**: Press the **'G'** key at any time to open the storage menu and view your currently buffered items.
* **Instant Hotbar Swapping**: While the menu is open (**'G'**), click any item to immediately swap it with the item in your active hotbar slot.
* **Auto-Retrieval**: Items will automatically move from the buffer into your inventory if a slot becomes available.
* **5-Minute Grace Period**: Items are held for exactly 300 seconds (5 minutes) before being cleared from the buffer.

---
